# Glance bookmark favicons — base64 data-URI store (ALL refs in ONE file)
# Format: <name>  <mime>  <data-uri>
# Used for icons the site blocks or that are unreachable; render them by
# pasting the data-uri verbatim into the yaml `icon:` property.
turkseed  image/x-icon  data:image/x-icon;base64,
ultra-cp  image/png  data:image/png;base64,
youtube  image/x-icon  data:image/x-icon;base64,
torrentleech  image/png  data:image/png;base64,
myanonamouse  image/x-icon  data:image/x-icon;base64,
redacted  image/png  data:image/png;base64,
seedpool  image/x-icon  data:image/x-icon;base64,
filelist  image/x-icon  data:image/x-icon;base64,
